before: A room decided every card as seen by its statuses alone. A card the editor alone refuses to decide (the engine plans no change for it, incomplete-group) was decided in the room, and a fold of the room's file gave other cell records than the live room.
after: Each copy composes the parts the cards are in and plans them with the engine's planRevisionBatch, as the editor plans the same decision (every item of a decision of many cards; one card's items that the editor plans with their dependencies). reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change. Every copy applies the same rule to the same document and leaves the same cards. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
